أَمِينٍ agrees with and qualifies مَقَامٍ.
جَنَّٰتٍ is governed by فِى in the locative phrase.
عُيُونٍ is coordinated with جَنَّٰتٍ by وَ under the same locative فِى.
سُندُسٍ is governed by مِن as the material phrase with يَلْبَسُونَ.
إِسْتَبْرَقٍ is coordinated with سُندُسٍ by وَ under مِن.
مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ is an accusative حال describing the subject of يَلْبَسُونَ.
ذَٰلِكَ is governed by prefixed كَ in كَذَٰلِكَ, framing زَوَّجْنَٰهُم adverbially.
The suffix هُم on زَوَّجْنَٰهُم is the direct object after the نَا subject marker.
حُورٍ is governed by بِ as the complement of زَوَّجْنَٰهُم.
عِينٍ qualifies حُورٍ in the same indefinite genitive phrase.
The pronoun هَا in فِيهَا is governed by فِي as a locative complement of يَدْعُونَ.
كُلِّ is governed by بِ with يَدْعُونَ to mark what they call for.
فَٰكِهَةٍ is the genitive complement of construct كُلِّ.
ءَامِنِينَ is an accusative حال describing the subject of يَدْعُونَ.
ٱلْمَوْتَ is the accusative direct object of يَذُوقُونَ.
The pronoun هَا in فِيهَا is governed by فِي as the locative complement of يَذُوقُونَ.
ٱلْمَوْتَةَ is introduced by إِلَّا as the exception to ٱلْمَوْتَ.
ٱلْأُولَىٰ qualifies ٱلْمَوْتَةَ.
وَقَىٰهُمْ is coordinated with يَذُوقُونَ by وَ at the clause level.
The suffix هُمْ on وَقَىٰهُمْ is an object pronoun of وَقَىٰ.
عَذَابَ is the explicit accusative complement governed by وَقَىٰهُمْ.
ٱلْجَحِيمِ is the genitive complement of construct عَذَابَ.
رَّبِّكَ is governed by مِن as the source phrase modifying فَضْلًا.
ٱلْفَوْزُ is the predicate of demonstrative ذَٰلِكَ, with هُوَ separating and emphasizing the predication.
ٱلْعَظِيمُ agrees with and qualifies ٱلْفَوْزُ.
The suffix هُ on يَسَّرْنَٰهُ is the direct object after the نَا subject marker.
لِسَانِكَ is governed by بِ as the medium of يَسَّرْنَٰهُ.
The suffix هُمْ is the ism of لَعَلَّ in لَعَلَّهُمْ.
يَتَذَكَّرُونَ supplies the predicate content of لَعَلَّهُمْ.
The suffix هُمْ is the ism of إِنَّ in إِنَّهُم.
مُّرْتَقِبُونَ is the khabar of إِنَّهُم.
